name: dgf-static-pipeline
description: Static long-form video pipeline: 2D doodle shots + Ken Burns + FFmpeg (no I2V)

scripts.new-episode: node -e "const n=process.argv[1]; if(!n) throw new Error('usage: npm run new-episode -- 004-my-topic'); require('fs').cpSync('templates/episode','episodes/'+n,{recursive:true}); console.log('Created episodes/'+n)"
